From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt/log ingestion & eval schedule — Borealis Analytics

Hi Alex / Samir,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment going into the POC kickoff: 

Summary of objectives
- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost on your support ticket summarization workload (avg. prompt length ~350 tokens)
- Measure QA quality using your existing human judgments and a small blind eval set
- Demonstrate stable throughput for concurrent agent workflows (target 100 qps sustained burst)

Success criteria (proposal)
1) Avg generation latency (p50/p95) meets your SLA: p50 <= 180ms, p95 <= 600ms for 512-token responses
2) Quality delta: model outputs meet or exceed your baseline F1/ROUGE thresholds on the eval set (we'll codify specific metrics once you send sample labels)
3) Cost target: reduce per-1000-token inference cost by >= 20% vs. current provider via batching + quantized variant
4) Reliability: no more than 1% error rate (timeouts/5xx) across 72-hour soak test

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Tue 5/4: Borealis provides a 500-sample prompt CSV (anonymized, see redaction guidance below) + 150 labelled examples for metric mapping
- Wed 5/5: Redwood ingests sample, returns a small report and asks clarifying prompt normalization questions
- Mon 5/10–Fri 5/14: Full trial run (staged); we run throughput tests, collect outputs for blind eval, and run cost simulations
- Mon 5/17: Joint readout and decision on next steps (scale or iterate)

Ownership & next steps
- Borealis owner for data delivery: Alex (alex.holmes@borealis.ai) — please confirm who will upload the prompt/log batch to the S3 share below
- Redwood owners: Karthik (trial lead), Marissa (integration/ingest ops), Priya (security & access compliance)

Data & redaction guidance (high level)
- Please remove PII from prompts and replace with stable tokens (e.g., [CUSTOMER_NAME], [ACCOUNT_ID])
- For logs, provide the original prompt, context fields, and the human label if available; CSV with columns: id, prompt, context, label
- Sample size: start with 500 rows (can be synthetic/anonymized) to validate ingest. Full batch expected: ~18k prompts.

S3 upload & permissions
- We will create a time-limited S3 bucket and share credentials (redwood-s3-borealis-poc). If you prefer, we can accept a secure transfer via your storage portal — let us know.

Attachments: redwood_poc_intake_checklist.pdf (intake fields + redaction checklist)

If this plan looks good, confirm the sample delivery date and we'll schedule the ingestion slot for Wed 5/5.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) We can get you a 500-sample CSV by EOD Wed 5/5. The dataset will be anonymized; we will replace PII with placeholders and include a mapping document for internal reference (not shared).
2) The 150 labelled examples exist but are spread across two teams — we will consolidate and send them along with the sample.
3) For the full batch, estimate is ~18k prompts and ~22k associated context rows (some prompts have multiple metadata rows). We expect to deliver that by 5/12 if the initial sample validates.

Minor ask: do you have a preferred CSV schema (header names) beyond id/prompt/context/label? Also confirm whether we should gzip the CSV before upload.

We'll also loop in our security lead if needed, but for now send the S3 share link and creds when ready.

—Alex
Alex Holmes
Head of ML Platform, Borealis Analytics
alex.holmes@borealis.ai

Hi Alex — perfect, thanks. Quick answers to your questions: 

Preferred schema
- id (string), prompt (text), context (json-string or pipe-delimited), label (optional, string), timestamp (ISO)
- If any of your context fields are nested, please flatten into pipe-delimited key=value pairs to keep CSV simple
- Gzip is fine and preferred for large batches (please name as borealis_prompts_YYYYMMDD.csv.gz)

Security & redaction
- Priya (cc'd) will be the Redwood contact for any security questionnaire or short terms-of-transfer questions. Priya: can you confirm the S3 bucket lifecycle (we'll set it to auto-delete after 30 days unless otherwise requested) and whether you need an IP allowlist?

Ingest & validation plan (high level)
- 5/5: Receive 500-sample CSV -> Redwood runs ingestion validation (schema, redaction checks) -> we return a short validation report with any normalization suggestions by EOD 5/5
- 5/6–5/9: Small batch runs + iterative tuning of batching/kv-cache settings
- 5/10: Start 72-hour soak test and blind eval capture

Action items for Borealis
- Deliver 500-sample CSV by 5/5 (Alex)
- Confirm owner for full batch delivery and expected size (Alex/Samir)

Action items for Redwood
- Set up time-limited S3 share and upload instructions (Karthik)
- Prepare initial eval harness and blind-eval template (Marissa)
- Security intake and minimal transfer terms (Priya)

I'll provision the S3 bucket and send creds later today. If you prefer a signed transfer agreement first, we can route through DocuSign (link below).

Best,
Karthik
